en.title: Bisrakh's Ravana Tradition
en.shortDescription: In Bisrakh, some residents regard Ravana as an ancestor, and local Navratri and Dussehra observances reflect that community tradition.
en.longDescription: Bisrakh, near Greater Noida West, carries a distinctive local tradition connected to the Ramayana. Residents interviewed by Outlook describe Ravana as an ancestor and explain why the village's Navratri and Dussehra practices differ from the effigy-burning celebrations common elsewhere. This is a story about living belief and local identity, not a claim that epic events can be verified as history.
en.narrationHint: Near Greater Noida West is Bisrakh, where some residents remember Ravana as an ancestor. Their Dussehra traditions show how one epic can live differently from village to village.

en.title: Swarna Jayanti Park, Indirapuram's Green Pause
en.shortDescription: Swarna Jayanti Park offers a public green space in Indirapuram, with jogging paths and boating listed among its recreation features.
en.longDescription: The route passes close to Swarna Jayanti Park in Indirapuram. Its public listing describes a park with jogging tracks and boating, a change of pace from the surrounding residential and road corridor. It is a small but useful reminder that neighborhood green spaces are part of the everyday geography of Ghaziabad.
en.narrationHint: Around Indirapuram, Swarna Jayanti Park offers a green pause from the apartment blocks and busy roads, with paths and boating among its listed features.

en.title: Akshardham's Modern Temple Craft
en.shortDescription: Inaugurated in 2005, Swaminarayan Akshardham brings traditional stone carving and devotional art into a modern Delhi cultural campus.
en.longDescription: Akshardham was inaugurated in New Delhi on 6 November 2005. Its official site describes a traditionally styled mandir built with intricately carved sandstone and marble, alongside exhibitions and gardens. Seen from the road, the complex connects contemporary Delhi with long-running traditions of devotional architecture and craft.
en.narrationHint: Just off this route stands Akshardham, a modern Delhi landmark inaugurated in 2005 and shaped by traditional stone carving and devotional art.

en.title: Noida Electronic City's Blue Line Terminus
en.shortDescription: Noida Electronic City is the eastern terminus of the Delhi Metro Blue Line, serving Sector 62 and nearby Noida-Ghaziabad neighborhoods.
en.longDescription: The Blue Line reaches Noida Electronic City in Sector 62, where the Delhi Metro lists Noida Electronic City as the service terminus. The station serves a work-and-residential corridor around Noida and Indirapuram, linking daily local travel to the wider NCR network.
en.narrationHint: Near Sector 62, the Blue Line ends at Noida Electronic City, a daily connection point for Noida and nearby Ghaziabad neighborhoods.
